description: Retry a failed, expired, or rejected workflow execution. Creates a new workflow execution on the same account, optionally re-using the original workflow definition and customer references.

callbackUrl.description: Optional callback URL override for the retry.

workflowDefinition.description: Optional override workflow definition. Defaults to the original workflow's definition.

workflowExecutionId.description: Original workflow execution id to retry.

name: retry_transaction
